data.title: A shark mug circles a quiet coastal breakfast
data.creativeFamily: clean coastal breakfast editorial built around the product's open shark-mouth rim and three-dimensional snout and fins
data.audience: Pinterest users saving shark gifts, funny coffee mugs, weird kitchen finds, coastal breakfast styling, and gifts for ocean lovers
data.hook: A bright, attainable breakfast scene registers first; the exact gray-and-white mug's open red shark mouth, teeth, snout, and fins become the second-look surprise.

product.name: Glazery 13.5-ounce gray 3D shark ceramic coffee mug (ASIN B0DFW4V57B)

references.lesson: Preserve one glossy 13.5-ounce mug with a gray shark face wrapping the front, white back and handle, projecting pointed snout, two small side fins, blue base rim, black dot eyes, and a wide irregular red mouth opening edged with blunt white teeth.

notes: The 2026-09-05 afternoon slot is assigned Arm A, so both generated attempts and any survivor must remain text-free apart from unavoidable unreadable background texture.

Concept 1, coastal breakfast: pale limestone, blue-striped linen, toast, and watery window reflections give the shark mug a useful breakfast setting and a product-specific ocean cue without turning it into a fantasy prop.

Concept 2, oceanographer flat lay: the mug sits with a blank blue field notebook, brass pencil, shell, and folded nautical chart; rejected before generation because the top-down angle would hide the projecting snout and wraparound shark face.

Concept 3, dark tide-pool still life: a moody blue tile counter and narrow dawn light make the red mouth and white teeth pop; selected as the contrasting second generation because it tests a materially different lighting and palette treatment while preserving an ordinary usable mug.
Click reason: the source-faithful open-mouth drinking rim is both useful and surprising; the scene invites a closer look without a headline or a bait-and-switch.

Stop conditions: reject any attempt that turns the mug into a living shark, adds a dorsal fin or extra teeth, changes the gray-white-red-blue color blocking, hides the handle or mouth opening, duplicates the mug, or introduces readable scene text.
